nodes.name: Interviewer
nodes.note: reads cards, marks them used, types notes and questions

nodes.name: Dashboard
nodes.note: CopilotPanel and copilot-store; mutes stay in the browser

nodes.name: WS handler
nodes.note: one loop per tab; broadcasts to every tab of the session

nodes.name: Pipeline
nodes.note: batches events, runs the graph, performs its effects, keeps the 30 s clock

nodes.name: Session graph
nodes.note: apply_events → fan-out → merge_results → actions; peer nodes added when the flag is on

nodes.name: LLM
nodes.note: Sonnet for peer calls, Haiku for coaching, tool loop for questions

nodes.name: Code graph
nodes.note: its latest values (code, snapshot id, is_stuck, bugs) ride into every session run

nodes.name: Report
nodes.note: gets the scorecard and the cards that were used
